summary: Verified bug fix for Despesas page invoice re-upload issue. Backend /api/expenses/extract handles two sequential uploads correctly (both return 200 with file_name + extracted). Frontend fix confirmed: file input value is reset to '' after each upload, 'Fatura carregada' + 'Carregar outra' UI is shown, and a second file selection triggers a new extraction without closing the dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correctly applied in 3 places (openNew/openEdit reset fileInputRef, handleUpload finally block resets, input has key prop tied to dialogOpen). Behavior verified end-to-end.

Minor: The `key={dialogOpen ? 'file-input-open' : 'file-input-closed'}` prop causes React to remount the input on open/close which alone would fix the issue; the ref clear is a belt-and-suspenders approach and does no harm.
seed_data_creation: None — used in-memory PNG bytes generated with PIL, uploaded via /api/expenses/extract (does not persist an expense record).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright verified: first upload triggers OCR (spinner -> 'Fatura carregada'), file input.value becomes '' after upload, second file selection via the same hidden input triggers OCR again without dialog close. Backend sequential extract test lives at /app/backend/tests/test_sequential_extract.py.
